metaDescription: What {brand} sells, what it doesn't, and how ordering, dispatch from {dispatchFrom}, delivery and returns work.

hero.title: A dresser full of good kitchen things
hero.lead: {brand} is an online shop for cookware, bakeware, tableware, glassware, cutlery, coffee and bar tools, storage and kitchen linen, sent to the {countries}.

shelves.title: What goes on our shelves
shelves.rangeBody: Everything we list is for cooking, serving, drinking or keeping a kitchen in order. The shop is sorted into the same categories you see in the menu:

listing.new: New stock only. Nothing used, refurbished or ex-display.
listing.photo: At least one photograph of the product and a written description.
listing.stock: Its stock status. A piece that has run out is marked “Sold out”.
listing.prices: A price you can view in {currencies}.

notSold.title: What we don't sell
notSold.lead: Some things are left out of the range on purpose.

items.electric: Electrical appliances, or anything that runs on a plug or a battery
items.knives: Kitchen knives, cleavers or other blades

order.label: Order
order.body: Add pieces to your bag and pay by card ({cardMethods}). Prices can be shown in {currencies}.

dispatch.label: Dispatch
dispatch.body: Orders are packed at {dispatchFrom} and are typically processed within {processingDays} of payment.

delivery.label: Delivery & returns
delivery.delivery: Delivery to the United Kingdom takes {uk}, and to EU member states {eu}. Standard delivery costs {cost}, and is free on orders of {threshold} or more.
delivery.returns: You can cancel within {days} days of receiving your order, without giving a reason.
delivery.warranty: Faults are covered by our {months}-month warranty.
